```{r}
agr <- d %>% 
  group_by(Experiment) %>% 
  reframe(MeanPropSimilar = mean(Response), 
          CILow = ci.low(Response), 
          CIHigh = ci.high(Response)) %>%
  mutate(YMin = MeanPropSimilar - CILow, 
         YMax = MeanPropSimilar + CIHigh)


# write.csv(agr,"../data/similarity_agg.csv")
```


```{r}

agr <- d %>% 
  group_by(Experiment,FeatureMatch) %>% 
  reframe(MeanPropSimilar = mean(Response), 
          CILow = ci.low(Response), 
          CIHigh = ci.high(Response)) %>%
  mutate(YMin = MeanPropSimilar - CILow, 
         YMax = MeanPropSimilar + CIHigh)
# View(agr)

good_colors <- c(
  "ValenceMatchingOnly" = "#00BFC4",
  "ConceptualMatchingOnly" = "#F8766D",
  "MaxMismatch" = adjustcolor("#F8766D", alpha.f = 0.4),  # lighter via alpha
  "MaxMatch" = adjustcolor("#00BFC4", alpha.f = 0.4),  # lighter via alpha
  "DissimilarControl" = "#999999",
  "SimilarControl" = "#999999"
)


dodge = position_dodge(.9)
ggplot(data=agr, aes(x=reorder(FeatureMatch,MeanPropSimilar),y=MeanPropSimilar, fill=FeatureMatch)) +
  geom_bar(position=dodge,stat="identity") + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=YMin,ymax=YMax),width=.25,position=position_dodge(0.9)) +
  facet_wrap(
      ~Experiment,
      ncol=4,
      labeller=label_wrap_gen(width=16)
      ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = good_colors) +
  theme(axis.title.x=element_blank(),
        axis.text.x=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
        text = element_text(family = "Helvetica"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),     # y-axis title
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12),     # y-axis ticks
        
        strip.text= element_text(size = 10)    # facet labels
        # legend.position = "none"# legend labels
      )

# ggsave("../graphs/simex-wide.pdf", width = 6, height = 3)
# ggsave("../graphs/simex-legend.pdf", width = 7, height = 8)

```

```{r}
names(d)
dcen <- d %>% 
  mutate(WordPair = as.factor(WordPair),
         ID.Ibex = as.factor(ID.Ibex),
         FeatureMatch = as.factor(FeatureMatch),
         Experiment = as.factor(Experiment),
         cResponse = as.numeric(Response)-mean(as.numeric(Response)))

m <- lmer(cResponse ~ FeatureMatch*Experiment + (1|WordPair) + (1+FeatureMatch|ID.Ibex), data = dcen)
summary(m)
```


# Looking at valence differences
```{r}

agr <- d %>% 
  filter(FeatureMatch)
  group_by(Experiment,FeatureMatch) %>% 
  reframe(MeanPropSimilar = mean(Response), 
          CILow = ci.low(Response), 
          CIHigh = ci.high(Response)) %>%
  mutate(YMin = MeanPropSimilar - CILow, 
         YMax = MeanPropSimilar + CIHigh)
# View(agr)

good_colors <- c(
  "ValenceMatchingOnly" = "#00BFC4",
  "ConceptualMatchingOnly" = "#F8766D",
  "MaxMismatch" = adjustcolor("#F8766D", alpha.f = 0.4),  # lighter via alpha
  "MaxMatch" = adjustcolor("#00BFC4", alpha.f = 0.4),  # lighter via alpha
  "DissimilarControl" = "#999999",
  "SimilarControl" = "#999999"
)


dodge = position_dodge(.9)
ggplot(data=agr, aes(x=reorder(FeatureMatch,MeanPropSimilar),y=MeanPropSimilar, fill=FeatureMatch)) +
  geom_bar(position=dodge,stat="identity") + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=YMin,ymax=YMax),width=.25,position=position_dodge(0.9)) +

      ~Experiment,
      ncol=4,
      labeller=label_wrap_gen(width=16)
      ) +
```
